title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Auditorium on 1967-11-11
lineage: SBD Reel from WB Vault to reel @ 7.5 IPS to reel@ 7.5 IPS to digital domain. Korg MR 1000 at 1 bit 5.6 mhz to 24-96 via Korg software. Taped by: Dan Healy; Transfer By: Matt Smith & Bob Menke; Mastering By: Derek McCabe

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of a funky, psychedelic 1967 show highlighted by masterful Jerry Garcia guitar work.
ai_review.review: The remastered tape sounds astonishingly clean for its age, delivering a crisp soundboard experience that lets listeners hear every nuance.  The performance is praised as a “funky and psychedelic night” with Jerry’s playing described as preternatural and older‑than‑his‑years, giving the show high energy throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave 4–5 stars and emphasized both superb recording quality and an energetic, musically strong performance, especially noting Jerry’s guitar work.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Remastered from a 1967 tape; reviewers call it "clean" and "preternatural" for its age, with no mention of drop‑outs or noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A funky, psychedelic night that holds its own despite a more celebrated show the previous evening.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for sounding like an older master; his tone and left‑ear playing are highlighted as exceptional.
